title: Ke kula a me ka hana
description: Ten short stories about school and work in Hawaiʻi: a hula teacher, a lifeguard, a banana grower, a cook, a lawyer, a radio translator, a boxing coach, a history class trip and a harbour worker.

lessons.title: Ka pahu a Kauilani
lessons.summary: Kauilani, a hula teacher at a Hawaiian-medium school in Kahului, teaches her class an old song with a hidden meaning, and the class dances it for their families.
lessons.text:
He kumu hula ʻo Kauilani ma kekahi kula kaiapuni ma Kahului. Ma ke kula kaiapuni, aʻo ʻia nā haumāna a pau ma ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi. I kēlā me kēia pule, aʻo ʻo Kauilani i kekahi haʻawina hula i ka papa ʻeono.

I kēia pule, he haʻawina hou kā ka papa: he mele no kekahi aliʻi hanohano o ka wā kahiko. Ua lawe mai ʻo Kauilani i kāna pahu. Ua hana ʻia ka pahu e kona kupuna. Ua hahau ʻo Kauilani i ka pahu me kona mau lima, a ua hula nā haumāna.

Ma hope o ka hula ʻana, ua ʻōlelo ʻo Kauilani i kekahi kaikamahine: "He kaona ko kēia mele. ʻIke ʻoe i ke kaona, e Keʻala?" ʻAʻole ʻo Keʻala i ʻike.

"ʻO ke kaona, ʻo ia ka manaʻo i loko o nā huaʻōlelo," wahi a ke kumu. "Ma kēia mele, ʻōlelo ʻia no kekahi lei. ʻO ke kaona naʻe, ʻo ke aliʻi ka lei. Hoʻohanohano ka mele i ke aliʻi hanohano."

Ua aʻo ʻia kēia mele i kēlā me kēia hanauna. Ua aʻo ke kupuna o Kauilani i kona makuahine, a ua aʻo kona makuahine iā Kauilani. ʻĀnō, ke aʻo nei ʻo Kauilani i ka hanauna hou.

Ua hoʻomaʻamaʻa ka papa i ka hula no ʻehā pule. "Maikaʻi ʻoe!" wahi a Kauilani iā Keʻala. "E hoʻomaʻamaʻa hou ʻoe i kou mau lima."

I ka lā hōʻike, ua lei nā haumāna i nā lei pua. Ua hahau ʻo Kauilani i ka pahu, a ua hula ka papa no nā ʻohana. Ua hoʻohanohano ka papa i ke aliʻi, a ua hoʻohanohano pū lākou i nā kūpuna.

Nā nīnau:
He kumu hula ʻo Kauilani?
ʻAe, he kumu hula ʻo ia ma kekahi kula kaiapuni ma Kahului.
He aha ke kaona o ka mele?
ʻO ke aliʻi ka lei. ʻO ia ke kaona.
Ua lei nā haumāna i nā lei?
ʻAe, ua lei lākou i nā lei pua.

lessons.title: Ka pō ma ka mauna
lessons.summary: Kapena, a science teacher in Waimea, takes his class up Maunakea on a cold, windy night to talk about climate and watch the stars.
lessons.text:
He kumu ʻepekema ʻo Kapena ma kekahi kula kiʻekiʻe ma Waimea, ma ka mokupuni ʻo Hawaiʻi. I kekahi pō, ua lawe ʻo ia i kāna mau haumāna i Maunakea.

Ma ke kaʻa, ua aʻo ʻo Kapena no ke aniau. "Wela ke aniau ma lalo o ka mauna," wahi āna. "Akā ma luna o ka mauna, anuanu ke aniau. I kekahi manawa, aia ka hau ma luna loa o ka mauna. He hau keʻokeʻo ma Hawaiʻi!"

Ua kū ke kaʻa ma kahi waena o ka mauna. "E noho ma kēia wahi no ka olakino," wahi a ke kumu. "Liʻiliʻi ka ea ma luna loa o ka mauna. Pono ka ea maikaʻi no ka olakino."

Ua iho nā haumāna mai ke kaʻa mai. Anuanu loa ka pō. Ua pā mai ka makani mai luna mai o ka mauna. Ua komo nā haumāna i nā lole nui.

He nui nā hōkū i ka lani. Ua kilokilo nā haumāna i ka lani a me nā hōkū. "I ka wā kahiko, kilokilo nā kānaka Hawaiʻi i nā hōkū o ka lani," wahi a Kapena. "Ua holo lākou ma ka moana me ka ʻike o nā hōkū."

Hoihoi loa ka pō i nā haumāna. Ua ʻike lākou i kekahi hōkū ʻulaʻula. "He mea hoihoi kēlā hōkū," wahi a kekahi keiki. Ma hope, ua pā hou mai ka makani anuanu, a ua hoʻi lākou i ke kaʻa.

Nā nīnau:
He kumu ʻepekema ʻo Kapena?
ʻAe, he kumu ʻepekema ʻo ia ma Waimea.
Anuanu ke aniau ma luna o ka mauna?
ʻAe, anuanu ke aniau ma luna o ka mauna.
Liʻiliʻi ka ea ma luna loa o ka mauna?
ʻAe, liʻiliʻi ka ea ma laila.
Ua kilokilo nā haumāna i nā hōkū?
ʻAe, ua kilokilo lākou i ka lani a me nā hōkū.
Hoihoi ka pō i nā haumāna?
ʻAe, hoihoi loa ka pō iā lākou.

lessons.title: Ke kahakai o Hanalei
lessons.summary: Kanahele, a lifeguard born in Hanalei, warns visitors about the deep water and finds a lost child by the river mouth.
lessons.text:
Mālama ʻo Kanahele i ka poʻe ma kekahi kahakai ma Hanalei, ma Kauaʻi. He kamaʻāina ʻo ia. Ua hānau ʻia ʻo ia ma Hanalei, a ʻike ʻo ia i nā wahi a pau o ke kahakai.

Hele mai nā malihini he nui i ke kahakai i kēlā me kēia lā. Pāʻani nā keiki ma ke one keʻokeʻo, a pāʻani nā mākua i ke kai.

I kēia lā, nui nā nalu. Ua hele ʻo Kanahele i kekahi ʻohana malihini ma ke one. "Hohonu ke kai ma laila, a nui nā nalu," wahi āna. "E pāʻani ma kēia ʻaoʻao. ʻAʻole hohonu ke kai ma kēia wahi."

Aia kekahi muliwai ma kekahi ʻaoʻao o ke kahakai. Iho mai ka wai o kekahi kahawai mai ka mauna mai, a komo ka wai o ke kahawai i ke kai ma ka muliwai. He nui nā iʻa liʻiliʻi ma ka muliwai.

Ma hope, ua holo mai kekahi makuahine malihini. "Ua nalowale ke keiki!" wahi āna. He 5 makahiki ke keiki. Ua huli ʻo Kanahele i ke keiki ma ke one a ma ke kai. Ua huli pū kekahi mau kamaʻāina, akā ʻaʻole i loaʻa ke keiki.

Ua noʻonoʻo ʻo Kanahele: "Makemake nā keiki i nā iʻa liʻiliʻi." Ua holo ʻo ia i ka muliwai, a ma laila, ua loaʻa iā ia ke keiki. E nānā ana ke keiki i nā iʻa ma ka wai. Ua lawe ʻo Kanahele i ke keiki i kona makuahine. "Mahalo nui!" wahi a ka makuahine.

Nā nīnau:
He kamaʻāina ʻo Kanahele?
ʻAe, he kamaʻāina ʻo ia. Ua hānau ʻia ʻo ia ma Hanalei.
Hohonu ke kai ma kahi o nā nalu nui?
ʻAe, hohonu ke kai ma laila.
Ua nalowale ke keiki o ka makuahine malihini?
ʻAe, ua nalowale ke keiki, akā ua huli ʻo Kanahele iā ia.
Ua loaʻa ke keiki ma ka muliwai?
ʻAe, ua loaʻa ke keiki ma ka muliwai.

lessons.title: Nā maiʻa o Hāmākua
lessons.summary: Kawaiola grows bananas in Hāmākua with four workers; when the price falls he plants fewer banana trees and gives the extra bananas to the school for free.
lessons.text:
He ʻāina maiʻa ko Kawaiola ma Hāmākua. ʻEhā āna limahana.

Kanu nā limahana i nā lāʻau maiʻa hou i kēlā me kēia mahina. Ma hope o 9 mahina, hōʻiliʻili lākou i ka maiʻa. Kaumaha ka maiʻa. Kaumaha kekahi pahu maiʻa e like me kekahi keiki. Ua hōʻiliʻili nā limahana i ka maiʻa, ua hoʻokomo lākou i ka maiʻa i loko o nā pahu, a ua lawe lākou i nā pahu kaumaha i ke kaʻa.

ʻO ka maiʻa ka huahana nui o ka ʻāina. He huahana ʻē aʻe nō hoʻi: ke kope. Kūʻai aku ʻo Kawaiola i kāna mau huahana i nā hale kūʻai ma Waimea.

I kēia makahiki, he nui loa ka maiʻa ma ka mokupuni, a ua emi ke kumukūʻai. Ma mua, he 30 kālā ke kumukūʻai o hoʻokahi pahu maiʻa. ʻĀnō, he 20 kālā wale nō. Ua emi ke kālā o Kawaiola.

"E hoʻēmi ana au i ka nui o nā lāʻau maiʻa hou," wahi a Kawaiola i kāna mau limahana. "E kanu ana au i ke kope ma kekahi ʻāpana o ka ʻāina." Ua hoʻēmi ʻo ia i ka maiʻa, a ua kanu ʻia ke kope.

ʻAʻole i kūʻai ʻia aku kekahi mau pahu maiʻa. No laila, ua hāʻawi manuahi ʻo Kawaiola i nā maiʻa i ke kula o ke kaiāulu. "He maiʻa manuahi no nā keiki!" wahi a kekahi kumu. Ua ʻai nā keiki i ka maiʻa manuahi.

Nā nīnau:
ʻEhia limahana a Kawaiola?
ʻEhā āna limahana.
Kaumaha ka maiʻa?
ʻAe, kaumaha ka maiʻa. Kaumaha kekahi pahu maiʻa e like me kekahi keiki.
ʻO ka maiʻa ka huahana nui o ka ʻāina?
ʻAe, ʻo ka maiʻa ka huahana nui o ka ʻāina.
Ua emi ke kumukūʻai o ka maiʻa?
ʻAe, ua emi ke kumukūʻai. He 20 kālā wale nō ka pahu.
Ua hāʻawi manuahi ʻo Kawaiola i nā maiʻa i ke kula?
ʻAe, ua hāʻawi manuahi ʻo ia i nā maiʻa i ke kula.

lessons.title: Ka ʻaina nui
lessons.summary: Kalikolehua cooks for big meals; she meets Ululani, agrees on a pig for her daughter's graduation meal, and roasts it from sunrise until night.
lessons.text:
Hana ʻo Kalikolehua i ka ʻai no nā ʻaina nui. He ʻoihana liʻiliʻi kāna ma Kāneʻohe.

I kekahi lā, ua kelepona mai ʻo Ululani. E puka ana kāna kaikamahine mai ke kula kiʻekiʻe, a makemake ʻo Ululani i kekahi ʻaina nui no ka ʻohana a me nā hoaaloha. Ua hālāwai lāua ma ke keʻena o Kalikolehua.

Ua kūkākūkā lāua no ka ʻaina. "Makemake au i ka puaʻa," wahi a Ululani. "Makemake nui ke keiki i ka puaʻa." E hele mai ana nā ʻohana he ʻumi. Ua kūkākūkā hou lāua no ke kālā. Ma hope, ua kākau ʻo Kalikolehua i kekahi ʻaelike. Aia ka ʻai, ka lā o ka ʻaina, a me ke kālā ma ka ʻaelike. Ua kākau ʻo Ululani i kona inoa ma ka ʻaelike.

I ka lā ma mua o ka ʻaina, ua pepehi ʻia kekahi puaʻa nui ma kekahi ʻāina ma Kahaluʻu. Pepehi ʻia ka puaʻa ma mua o ka ʻaina nui. Ua lawe koke ʻia mai ka puaʻa i ka hale o Kalikolehua. Ua hana ʻo ia i kekahi ahi nui i loko o kekahi lua ma ka honua. Ua kau ʻia ka puaʻa ma luna o ke ahi mai ka puka ʻana o ka lā ā hiki i ka pō. Ua noho ʻo Kalikolehua ma ka ʻaoʻao o ke ahi ā pō.

I ka lā o ka ʻaina, ua hele mai nā ʻohana he ʻumi. Ua ʻai lākou i ka puaʻa a me ka iʻa. Ua pau koke ka puaʻa! "Maikaʻi loa kēia ʻaina," wahi a Ululani. "Mahalo nui iā ʻoe!"

Nā nīnau:
Hana ʻo Kalikolehua ma Kāneʻohe?
ʻAe, he ʻoihana liʻiliʻi kāna ma Kāneʻohe.
Ua hālāwai ʻo Kalikolehua me Ululani?
ʻAe, ua hālāwai lāua ma ke keʻena o Kalikolehua.
Makemake ʻo Ululani i ka puaʻa?
ʻAe, makemake ʻo ia i ka puaʻa.
ʻEhia ʻohana i hele mai?
Ua hele mai nā ʻohana he ʻumi.
Ua pau koke ka puaʻa?
ʻAe, ua pau koke ka puaʻa.

lessons.title: Ka loio ma Līhuʻe
lessons.summary: A young man arrested for drunk driving wants to deny it; his lawyer Kaʻohu reads the police report and urges him to admit it, so his punishment is small.
lessons.text:
He loio ʻo Kaʻohu ma Līhuʻe. I kekahi lā, ua hele mai kekahi kanaka ʻōpio i kona keʻena. ʻO Kekumu kona inoa. "Ua hopu ʻia au e nā mākaʻi i ka pō nei no ka ʻona," wahi āna.

Ua noi ka loio iā Kekumu e haʻi mai i nā mea kikoʻī a pau. Ua hele ʻo Kekumu i ka hale o kekahi hoaaloha, a ua ʻona ʻo ia ma laila. Ma hope, ua hoʻokele ʻo ia i kona kaʻa ma ka ʻaoʻao hewa o ke alanui nui. Ua ʻike nā mākaʻi i kona kaʻa, a ua hopu lākou iā ia ma ke alanui.

"ʻAʻole au i ʻona," wahi a Kekumu. Makemake ʻo ia e hōʻole. Ua nānā ʻo Kaʻohu i ka palapala kikoʻī o nā mākaʻi. Ma ka palapala, ua ʻona ʻo Kekumu.

"Mai hōʻole," wahi a ka loio. "Ke koi aku nei au iā ʻoe: e ʻae i ka hewa." Ua koi hou ʻo ia. Ma hope, ua ʻae ʻo Kekumu.

Ua hoʻokolokolo ʻia ʻo Kekumu ma ka hale hoʻokolokolo ma Līhuʻe. He mau minuke wale nō ka hoʻokolokolo ʻana: ʻumi minuke paha. "Ua ʻona au. Ua hewa au," wahi a Kekumu i ka luna kānāwai. ʻAʻole ʻo ia i hōʻole.

Ua hoʻopaʻi ka luna kānāwai iā ia. ʻO ka hoʻopaʻi: e uku ʻo Kekumu i 500 kālā, a ʻaʻole hiki iā ia ke hoʻokele kaʻa no ʻeono mahina. "He hoʻopaʻi liʻiliʻi kēia, no ka mea ʻaʻole ʻoe i hōʻole," wahi a ka loio.

Nā nīnau:
Na wai i hopu iā Kekumu?
Na nā mākaʻi i hopu iā ia.
Ua ʻona ʻo Kekumu?
ʻAe, ua ʻona ʻo ia.
Ua hōʻole ʻo Kekumu ma ka hoʻokolokolo ʻana?
ʻAʻole. ʻAʻole ʻo ia i hōʻole.
ʻEhia minuke ka hoʻokolokolo ʻana?
He mau minuke wale nō: ʻumi minuke paha.
Liʻiliʻi ka hoʻopaʻi o Kekumu?
ʻAe, liʻiliʻi kona hoʻopaʻi, no ka mea ʻaʻole ʻo ia i hōʻole.

lessons.title: Ka unuhi ʻana ma ka lekiō
lessons.summary: Nāpua translates the day's political stories into Hawaiian for a radio programme in Honolulu and answers a letter from an old woman on Molokaʻi.
lessons.text:
Hana ʻo Nāpua ma kekahi lekiō ma Honolulu. He polokalamu ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi kāna ma ka lekiō i kēlā me kēia lā. Ma mua o ka polokalamu, unuhi ʻo Nāpua i nā moʻolelo o ka lā mai ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia i ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi. Paʻakikī ka unuhi ʻana i kekahi manawa, akā he hana leʻaleʻa ia. Leʻaleʻa ʻo Nāpua i kāna hana.

I kēia lā, he nui nā moʻolelo kālaiʻāina. Ua koho ʻia kekahi kiaʻāina hou no Hawaiʻi. E loli ana nā kānāwai he nui. E loli ana ke kānāwai no nā kaʻa, a e loli ana ke kānāwai no nā kula. Ua unuhi ʻo Nāpua i nā moʻolelo kālaiʻāina a pau, a ua ʻōlelo ʻo ia ma ka lekiō.

Hoʻouna mai nā kānaka i nā leka i ka lekiō. Hoʻouna kekahi poʻe i nā leka uila. Ma hope o ka polokalamu, ua wehe ʻo Nāpua i kekahi leka mai kekahi kupuna wahine ma Molokaʻi.

"Mahalo no ka unuhi ʻana," wahi a ka leka. "ʻAʻole au i ʻike i ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia o ke kālaiʻāina. ʻIke au i ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi. Ma ka polokalamu, ʻike au i nā mea e loli ana ma ka ʻāina."

Ua kākau ʻo Nāpua i kekahi leka i ke kupuna wahine, a ua hoʻouna ʻo ia i ka leka i Molokaʻi.

Nā nīnau:
Unuhi ʻo Nāpua i nā moʻolelo mai ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia?
ʻAe, unuhi ʻo ia mai ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia i ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi.
He nui nā moʻolelo kālaiʻāina i kēia lā?
ʻAe, he nui nā moʻolelo kālaiʻāina. E loli ana nā kānāwai he nui.
Na wai i hoʻouna i ka leka?
Na kekahi kupuna wahine ma Molokaʻi i hoʻouna i ka leka.
Ua hoʻouna ʻo Nāpua i kekahi leka i ke kupuna wahine?
ʻAe, ua hoʻouna ʻo ia i kekahi leka i Molokaʻi.

lessons.title: Ke kaikuaʻana a me ke kaikaina
lessons.summary: Kaniho, a boxing coach in Kalihi, trains his younger brother Alapaki for a big fight; Alapaki falls once, gets up and wins.
lessons.text:
He kumu mokomoko ʻo Kaniho ma kekahi hale hoʻoikaika kino ma Kalihi. ʻO kāna hana, ʻo ke aʻo ʻana i ka mokomoko i nā ʻōpio. ʻO Alapaki kona kaikaina. Ua hānau ʻia ʻo Alapaki ʻehiku makahiki ma hope o kona kaikuaʻana.

I kēlā me kēia lā, hoʻomaʻamaʻa ʻo Alapaki me kona kaikuaʻana. "E nānā i kou mau wāwae!" wahi a Kaniho. "Ma ka mokomoko, nui ka hana a nā wāwae, ʻaʻole ka hana a nā lima wale nō." Ua neʻe ʻo Alapaki ma kona mau wāwae, a ua hoʻoikaika ʻo ia.

ʻO ka pahuhopu o Alapaki, ʻo ka lanakila ma ka paio nui o Honolulu. No ʻehiku pule, ua hoʻomaʻamaʻa ke kaikaina, a ua aʻo ke kaikuaʻana iā ia. Kālele ʻo Alapaki i kona kaikuaʻana.

I ka lā o ka paio, ua kū ʻo Alapaki me kekahi ʻōpio ikaika mai Kapolei mai. Ma ka puni mua, ua hahau ke kanaka mai Kapolei i ke poʻo o Alapaki, a ua hāʻule ʻo Alapaki i lalo. Ua kū hou ʻo ia. Ua kālele ʻo ia i nā ʻōlelo a kona kaikuaʻana: "E nānā i kou mau wāwae!"

Ma ka puni ʻekolu, ua hāʻule ke kanaka mai Kapolei. Ua lanakila ʻo Alapaki ma ka paio. Ua hoʻokō ʻo ia i kona pahuhopu. Ua hoʻomaikaʻi ʻo Kaniho i kona kaikaina: "Maikaʻi loa ʻoe!" Ua hoʻomaikaʻi pū ka poʻe o ka hale hoʻoikaika kino iā lāua.

Nā nīnau:
He kumu mokomoko ʻo Kaniho?
ʻAe, he kumu mokomoko ʻo ia ma Kalihi.
ʻO wai ke kaikaina o Kaniho?
ʻO Alapaki ke kaikaina o Kaniho.
He aha ka pahuhopu o Alapaki?
ʻO ka lanakila ma ka paio nui o Honolulu.
Ua hāʻule ʻo Alapaki ma ka puni mua?
ʻAe, ua hāʻule ʻo ia, akā ua kū hou ʻo ia.
Ua hoʻomaikaʻi ʻo Kaniho i kona kaikaina?
ʻAe, ua hoʻomaikaʻi ʻo ia iā Alapaki.

lessons.title: Ka huakaʻi i Puʻukoholā
lessons.summary: History teacher Makanani takes her class to visit Puʻukoholā, the temple Kamehameha built at Kawaihae, where they see a model and pass stones hand to hand.
lessons.text:
He kumu mōʻaukala ʻo Makanani. I kekahi lā, ua kipa ʻo ia me kāna mau haumāna i Puʻukoholā ma Kawaihae. Aia ʻo Kawaihae ma ke kalana ʻo Hawaiʻi. He luakini ʻo Puʻukoholā. Ua kūkulu ʻia ka luakini e Kamehameha i ka makahiki 1791.

Aia ka luakini ma kekahi ʻāina ākea. He ʻāina ākea ia no nā kānaka a pau, a mālama ʻia ka ʻāina e ke aupuni, ʻaʻole e ke kalana. Kipa mai nā kānaka he nui i kēia wahi.

Ua kūkulu ʻia ka luakini me nā pōhaku ʻeleʻele. "He kanaka naʻauao ʻo Kamehameha," wahi a Makanani. "Ua hele mai kona pūʻali ma nā waʻa he nui. Ua kū nā kānaka o ka pūʻali, a ua hāʻawi lima lākou i nā pōhaku ʻeleʻele mai kekahi kanaka a i kekahi kanaka."

Ma ka hale hōʻikeʻike, ua ʻike nā haumāna i kekahi hoʻohālike liʻiliʻi o ka luakini, me nā waʻa liʻiliʻi a me nā kānaka liʻiliʻi o ka pūʻali. Ma hope, ua hoʻohālike nā haumāna i ka hana a ka pūʻali: ua kū lākou, a ua hāʻawi lima lākou i nā pōhaku ʻeleʻele.

Ma waho, ua ʻike lākou i ʻelua manu kōlea ma ka ʻāina ākea. "Lele mai ke kōlea mai ka ʻāina ʻē mai i kēlā me kēia makahiki," wahi a ke kumu. "Naʻauao ke kōlea: ʻike ʻo ia i ke ala ma luna o ka moana."

Nā nīnau:
Ua kipa ka papa i Puʻukoholā?
ʻAe, ua kipa lākou i Puʻukoholā ma Kawaihae.
Na wai i kūkulu i ka luakini?
Na Kamehameha i kūkulu i ka luakini.
Ua hele mai ka pūʻali ma nā waʻa?
ʻAe, ua hele mai ka pūʻali ma nā waʻa he nui.
Ua ʻike nā haumāna i kekahi hoʻohālike ma ka hale hōʻikeʻike?
ʻAe, ua ʻike lākou i kekahi hoʻohālike liʻiliʻi o ka luakini.
Ua ʻike lākou i nā manu kōlea?
ʻAe, ua ʻike lākou i ʻelua manu kōlea ma ka ʻāina ākea.

lessons.title: Ka ʻīlio ma ke awa
lessons.summary: Nāhoa unloads cargo from ships at Kahului harbour, step by step, while his dog follows him; the dog finds a box left behind before he shuts the big gate.
lessons.text:
Hana ʻo Nāhoa ma ke awa moku o Kahului ma Maui. Hōʻea mai nā moku mai Honolulu mai a mai ʻAmelika mai. Hoʻoili ʻo Nāhoa a me kāna mau hoa hana i nā ukana mai nā moku a i nā kaʻa ukana.

He ʻīlio ko Nāhoa. Hahai ka ʻīlio iā Nāhoa i ka hana i kēlā me kēia lā. Ma nā wahi a pau, hahai ka ʻīlio ma hope ona.

He kaʻina hana ko ka hoʻoili ʻana. Ma mua, nānā ʻo Nāhoa i ka palapala o ka ukana. Ma hope, hoʻoili lākou i ka ukana mai ka moku, a waiho lākou i ka ukana ma kahi kokoke i ka puka nui. ʻO ka hope, hoʻoili hou lākou i ka ukana i nā kaʻa ukana. Mālama ʻo Nāhoa i kēia kaʻina i kēlā me kēia lā.

I kēia lā, ua hōʻea mai kekahi moku nui me ʻewalu pahu nui. Ma ka hopena o ka lā, ua ʻike ka ʻīlio i kekahi pahu ma kahi ʻē. Ua waiho ʻia ka pahu ma laila. Ua noho ka ʻīlio ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka pahu.

Ua ʻike ʻo Nāhoa i ka pahu, a ua hoʻoili ʻo ia i ka pahu i ke kaʻa ukana. Ma hope, ua pani ʻo Nāhoa i ka puka nui o ke awa. Ua hoʻi ʻo ia i kona hale, a ua hahai ka ʻīlio ma hope ona.

Nā nīnau:
Hana ʻo Nāhoa ma Kahului?
ʻAe, hana ʻo ia ma ke awa moku o Kahului.
Hahai ka ʻīlio iā Nāhoa i ka hana?
ʻAe, hahai ka ʻīlio ma hope ona i kēlā me kēia lā.
ʻEhia pahu nui ma ka moku?
ʻEwalu pahu nui ma ka moku.
Ua waiho ʻia kekahi pahu ma kahi ʻē?
ʻAe, ua waiho ʻia kekahi pahu ma kahi ʻē, a ua noho ka ʻīlio ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka pahu.
Ua pani ʻo Nāhoa i ka puka nui?
ʻAe, ua pani ʻo ia i ka puka nui.
